steps.description: Build the master Gantt chart, quote the customer, and put the investment case together.
activities: Build detail-level Gantt chart (BOM setup, certification, tooling, jig, trial, MP-plan dates)
Issue quotation to customer
Complete design checklist and confirm with Ningbo (NB) team
Identify certification scope (CB, CE-EMC, etc.)
Raise Investment Request (IR) for molds, tools, certification, machines
Classify product complexity (AA/A/B/C or A/B/C/D/E)
Confirm RACI assignment across all departments
steps.gate_criteria: Gantt chart approved; IR submitted; design checklist signed off by NB team; product class assigned
steps.source_note: DESIGN-CHK is not named in QA-SOP-NPI-0001-05 or the RACI matrix; it appears only in the 9649 case study, so it is tracked but does not block the gate.

steps.description: Tear down an actual sample and confirm the design is manufacturable.
activities: Design review on physical sample (tear-down analysis)
Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM) pass on machines and tooling
Routing and layout draft initiated by IE (2026 upgrade: now starts here)
Work Instructions drafting begins from physical FG sample shared by Ningbo
steps.gate_criteria: DFM signed off; tear-down findings documented; routing/layout draft started

steps.description: Finalize DFM, draft the PFMEA, and start mold fabrication.
activities: Finalize DFM for machines and tooling
Draft Process PFMEA (2026 upgrade: Production, IE, QA involved from this step)
Begin mold making and vacuum-metallization (VM) jig fabrication
Prepare EP (Engineering Pilot) samples
Draft trial-production plan for the new SKU
steps.gate_criteria: PFMEA draft complete; mold fabrication started; EP sample plan defined

steps.description: Fabricate the mold, then run T0/T1/T2 samples against spec.
activities: Molding tool fabricated and tested at vendor site
T0/T1/T2 sample rounds functionally tested against product specification
Mold tested in-house at Wahl Vietnam
Supplier process capability evaluated
steps.gate_criteria: T0/T1/T2 samples pass functional test; mold approved for production; supplier capability confirmed

steps.description: Get the EP sample and jig output signed off by the customer.
activities: VM-jig samples produced and submitted to customer for approval
EP (Engineering Pilot) sample built
Inspection Standard drafted and sent for customer approval
Control Plan finalized
IQC, IPQC, OQC SOPs prepared
Assembly SOPs drafted
steps.gate_criteria: EP sample approved by customer; Inspection Standard signed off; Control Plan finalized; SOPs ready for training
steps.source_note: Old-stock clearance is mandated by QA-SOP-NPI-0002-03 (ECN), not by the NPI SOP. Retained here as WVN practice, not as an SOP requirement.

steps.description: Run the line for real, under a signed Trial Request Form.
activities: Confirm quality, safety, SOP, and BOM via Trial Request Form (QA-F-GEN-0010) signed by all related departments
Set up line: tools, jigs, and machines in place
Train Operators and Team Leads against SOP
Log every trial issue with assigned action owner
Prepare PPAP documentation on advice from Ningbo (2026 upgrade)
Run pilot production: at least 3 batches (1000 / 2000 / 5000 units per QA-SOP-NPI-0001-05)
PFMEA reviewed and updated post-trial

trial_quantity.note: Trial quantities per QA-SOP-NPI-0001-05 Rev 05; may change with departmental alignment

steps.gate_criteria: Trial Request signed by all departments; all trial issues logged and closed; PPAP package submitted; training records complete
steps.source_note: PPAP is customer-driven, not required on every project; 8D-CAPA applies only when a trial produces a nonconformity. Both are tracked, not gating.

steps.description: Watch capacity climb to target, and bank what was learned.
activities: Monitor new-SKU capacity against class-based ramp-up target
Log issues as the line stabilizes
Apply Kaizen suggestions to cut cost, reduce complexity, improve quality
Capture lessons learned (LL INFO) for future projects
Conduct NPI Closure Validation (RACI row 5.7)
Transfer to Supply Chain for ongoing mass production
steps.gate_criteria: Capacity target achieved within class-based timeline; NPI Closure Validation signed; project transferred to Supply Chain

npi_workflow.source_note: The 7-step model comes from the EPM pillar decks (Nov-2025 / Jul-2026), not from QA-SOP-NPI-0001-05, which does not enumerate 7 steps.

steps.description: Engineering Change request received from WCC/Customer/WVN or triggered by new product launch.
steps.gate_criteria: QA-F-GEN-0011/0024 Engineering Change Request form submitted

steps.description: Relevant departments evaluate the EC request. 5M analysis: Material, Method (Process), Machine (Tools), Manpower, Money (Cost).
steps.gate_criteria: 5M impact analysis completed by all relevant departments

steps.description: Detailed 5M impact documentation: check and analyze Material, Process, Machine, Manpower, Cost changes.
steps.gate_criteria: 4M Change Evaluation (QA-F-GEN-0017) completed for each affected dimension
steps.source_note: Not a separate row in QA-SOP-NPI-0002-03 - the 5M evaluation sits inside row 2. Kept as its own step because the team works it that way, but it is a practice step, not an SOP step.

steps.description: If any 5M dimension is affected, Project Leader updates Board of Management (MWER) and Customer, and obtains formal approval.
steps.gate_criteria: Approved QA-F-GEN-0011/0024 with MWER and Customer sign-off

steps.description: Relevant departments (Production, QC, R&D, Purchasing, Material Planning, Warehouse, etc.) form the EC project team. Minute meeting documented.
steps.gate_criteria: Kick-off meeting minutes documented; project team roster confirmed

steps.description: EC implementation plan and instruction plan created. Kick-off meeting with all relevant personnel. Drawing and EC record distributed.
steps.gate_criteria: EC implementation plan approved; kick-off minutes signed; drawings and EC record distributed to all stakeholders
steps.source_note: QA-SOP-NPI-0002-03 row 6 says the implementation plan is created and a kick-off meeting held - there is no sign-off language. The signed gate here was invented by v2.0 and has been removed.

steps.description: Update BOM in AX (quantity, specification), update Master Data, update Route if needed. Run Cost Roll Up and update Customer Quotation.
steps.gate_criteria: BOM updated; Master Data updated; Route updated; Cost Roll Up executed; new quotation sent to Customer

steps.description: Sourcing issues EC to suppliers with updated BOM and drawings. Contact supplier for trial production materials. Send debit note to customer if required.
steps.gate_criteria: EC issued to suppliers; trial material orders placed; debit note issued if applicable

steps.description: Warehouse follows EC to manage stock: check quantities per item, determine running change vs. quarantine vs. scrap, follow FIFO procedure, manage quarantine/scrap if required.
steps.gate_criteria: Stock assessment complete; disposition (running change/quarantine/scrap) decided per item; departments notified

steps.description: Material Planning schedules trial production with EC update. Production, QC, and R&D plan 5M-related changes: tooling modify schedule, material testing, etc. Evaluate 4M after change in initial production.
steps.gate_criteria: Trial production scheduled; 4M evaluation completed post-change; 4M update (WI, process) documented

steps.description: Conduct trial production if needed. Minimum 3 trials at 2000, 5000, and 10000 products. Full-process evaluation required: e.g., molding change must be evaluated with assembly line. In case of failure, project team troubleshoots with action plan before re-trial.
steps.gate_criteria: At least 3 trial batches complete (2000/5000/10000); trial report approved; all issues closed or action plan in place
steps.source_note: QA-SOP-NPI-0002-03 row 8 says trial production is run 'if needed' - the trial is conditional, so this gate is an operational convention.

steps.description: EC fully implemented. Mass production procedure initiated. All documentation finalized and archived per QA-SOP-GEN-0002 Control of Records.
steps.gate_criteria: All EC documentation closed; SOP/WI updated; mass production running; project archived
steps.source_note: QA-SOP-NPI-0002-03 row 14 states only 'mass production procedure' with no sign-off language; this gate is an operational convention.

ecn_workflow.source_note: 12 operational steps mapped onto the QA-SOP-NPI-0002-03 row structure; step 3 is a practice split, not an SOP row.

Simple.description: Accessory-only changes: intro book, card, color box, PDQ, printing plastic box

Medium.description: Plastic shell color change, blister-card changes, shell color + packaging

Very Complex.description: New production tooling/equipment required; full transfer project

trial_quantity_presets.sop_reference: QA-SOP-NPI-0001-05 specifies 1000/2000/5000 baseline; ECN Procedure specifies 2000/5000/10000 for EC-driven trials. Actual quantities may change with Production-Quality-NPI-IE alignment.

npi.source: QA-SOP-NPI-0001-05: 'at least 3 times in batches of 1000, 2000 and 5000 products'

sop_baselines.note: The Simple/Medium/Very Complex presets below are WVN practice conventions and sit BELOW both SOP baselines. Using them is a documented deviation from the SOP.

Sourcing.raci_role: Responsible for supplier validation and EC issuance

IE.raci_role: Responsible for routes, time study, line balancing

Finance.raci_role: Responsible for cost roll-up, quotation, debit notes

Supply_Chain.raci_role: Responsible for coverage groups, buyer groups, FG planning

Warehouse.raci_role: Responsible for stock management during EC, FIFO, quarantine/scrap

HR.raci_role: Informed; manages training records and skill matrix

Design.raci_role: External: provides product design, drawings, specifications

aa_a_b_c.description: EXTERNAL BENCHMARK ONLY (Tarkett WCM EEM) - not a Wahl Vietnam classification and not referenced by any Wahl source document. Kept for comparison; do not classify projects with it. The live scheme is A-E, see change_types.

abcde.description: Expanded 5-tier scheme applied to new SKUs since 2025 (from thesis analysis)

A.driver: Packaging-Only Change - Box, card, colour box, PDQ and printing changes only - no product hardware change.

B.driver: Blister Card Change Only - Blister and blister-card changes; product itself unchanged.

C.driver: Housing Unit Change Only - Housing unit changed - new or modified plastic tooling required.

D.driver: Housing Surface Change Only - Surface finish, texture or colour of the housing changes; geometry does not.

E.driver: New Product Development (Seed Develop) - Brand-new product development. New production tooling and equipment required.
